title: Repair SRD source authority, provenance, segmentation, and retrieval metadata
description:
Own source-authority and structural source-fidelity repairs for the SRD pack, plus
pack-side identities and relationships needed by runtime discovery. Strong exhaustive
checks remain appropriate where the licensed source independently supplies the
structural denominator. Pack aliases, relationships, and indexes are discovery inputs,
not proof of universal runtime discovery completeness.
acceptance_criteria:
- No generated content is presented as SRD-sourced without authoritative source/license support and correct provenance.
- Known segmentation, continuation, locator, and synthesized-label defects are repaired with source-side evidence.
- Stable identities/aliases/relationships needed by discovery are source-faithful and non-exclusive.
- Exhaustive coverage claims identify the source-derived structural population they cover.
- Pack-side indexes/relationships do not claim universal runtime discovery completeness.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
